$description: tailwind.config.js does not override theme.spacing, so spacing utilities use Tailwind's default 4px-step scale. Listed: every default step used >=5 times in src/**/*.jsx (padding/margin/gap utilities), with usage counts. Arbitrary px spacing (py-[108px], pt-[72px], gap-[72px] ...) is common and is recorded under arbitraryPx; the recurring section paddings are tokenised in 30-layout/section-rhythm.json.
